findings.title: Reconcile evidence against all native attempts, not only observed ones
findings.body: `finish()` builds the expected-attempt set exclusively from `self.attempts`, which is populated only when a live PW PID is sampled. If an entire native attempt falls between polls, it contributes no missing-rank entry; likewise, a restart that consumes completed force/queue caches does not validate the earlier attempts' runtime evidence. `launch.py:181–184` consequently accepts an empty or incomplete observation set and writes `status=complete` despite lacking the required post-banner rank/resource evidence. Reconcile the observations against the durable native command/result attempt identities used by the queue, requiring either this invocation's evidence or explicitly validated prior evidence for reused boundaries; mark unsampled attempts as missing rather than omitting them.

findings.title: Bind ownership to live ancestry before recording a PID
findings.body: `descendants()` returns bare PID numbers, and both `NativeObserver.poll()` and this rescan acquire their start ticks only afterward. If a descendant exits and its PID is reused before `identity(pid)`, the replacement process is inserted into `observer.owned` with its own valid start time, without checking that it still belongs to this launcher. Subsequent identity checks therefore authenticate the unrelated replacement, and `stop_owned()` sends TERM/KILL to it and its process group; the separate `getpgid()`/`killpg()` sequence also permits group reuse after validation. This can terminate another same-user workload during NC1 shutdown. Establish ancestry/session ownership together with a stable process handle, retain that handle for signalling, and do not derive group-wide signals from unchecked/reused numeric PIDs.

findings.title: Validate each sampled TID's identity and thread-group membership
findings.body: The affinity read uses only the numeric TID obtained from an earlier `/proc/<pid>/task` directory listing. If that thread exits and its TID is reused before `sched_getaffinity()`, the call can succeed for a thread in another process rather than raising `ProcessLookupError`. The later leader-PID start-time check does not detect this: the unrelated affinity is saved as NC1 evidence and can trigger `_check()`'s permanent resource failure, stopping an otherwise compliant calculation. Read and revalidate each task's start identity and membership around the affinity read, and record a changed/disappeared task as a sampling gap instead of attributing the replacement thread to this rank.

findings.title: Reject an MPI launcher outside the frozen executable identity
findings.body: If the service's PATH resolves `mpirun` to a different executable, this preflight still succeeds as long as the previously frozen `/usr/bin/mpirun` remains unchanged: it hashes the recorded paths but never checks which launcher the consumer will select. `catdft.qe_stage._launch()` subsequently calls `shutil.which("mpirun")` again and executes that result, while `NativeObserver` validates only PW processes, so an unbound MPI launcher can execute without a frozen-input refusal. Pin the recorded launcher into the executed command or compare the runtime resolution and digest with the receipt before spawning the queue.

independent_slices.responsibility: Stable live-ancestry-authorized pidfd ownership, fd-based signaling/reaping, per-TID start/group membership around affinity reads.
independent_slices.interface: ProcessHandle exposes pid,start_ticks,pidfd,proc_fd (retained open proc directory), alive(), signal(signum). OwnedProcesses(root_pid): refresh()->tuple[ProcessHandle], live()->tuple[ProcessHandle], signal_all(signum)->list[int], reap(exclude_pid=None), close(). sample_task_affinities(handle)->dict with affinities dict[TID,list[CPU]], task_identities dict[TID,{start_ticks,tgid}], gaps list[dict]. Never killpg or signal numeric PID. Bind and cross-check pidfd/proc_fd to the same live identity and confirm ancestry while child/ancestor handles are retained; bare PID discovery is not authority. Proc observations use openat/readlinkat or OS traversal of retained proc_fd, never userland resolve of its proc magic-link into a reusable PID path. Keep adopted original descendants owned through handles; root subreaper precedes construction. Bound handle lifetime; reap only owned children via P_PIDFD; Popen owns its leader status. Per-TID affinity requires unchanged start/group membership before and after the read, otherwise a gap, not foreign CPU evidence.

independent_slices.expected_cases: All newly created forces/<geometry>/scf/attempts/<uuid>/command.json directories, including wholly unobserved attempts; every completed forces/<geometry>/scf/result.json attempt used by durable cache. Baseline incomplete/failed abandoned attempts are retained without becoming new successes. Do not omit an attempt because no PID was sampled. Reused completed force data requires explicitly revalidated prior evidence; empty new observations are not a license.
independent_slices.proof_authority: Frozen manifest/root relaxation specs and publication receipt authorize executables/model/units/environment. Require five unique post-banner rank snapshots from one actual attempt/invocation with matching copied native inputs, immutable root spec hashes, rank/world/env/all-task evidence, kernel caps and loaded-object closure. Validate snapshot event SHA and relevant observed violations from the same invocation; missing final summary after an actual kill must not erase valid original raw post-banner evidence for an already completed force. Never invent resource observations, relabel old evidence as new, or recompute completed physical data merely to repair a metadata index.
